title: Black Witch Mirror Manga to End in 4th Volume
content: Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Yonan Togawa 's Black Witch Mirror ( Kokufu Kyōdan ) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 15, 2027.

title: Witch Watch Season 2 Premieres 2027
content: Witch Watch Season 2 is set to premiere in 2027. A teaser visual featuring the main character Nico Wakatsuki was also released. The second season was previously announced immediately after the first season’s finale, which premiered on October 5, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: SPITZ Band's Drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama Seriously Injured in Traffic Accident
content: The official website for Japanese rock band SPITZ announced on Sunday that its drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama was rushed to the hospital after sustaining serious injuries across his entire body in a traffic accident.
